gathering.speaker: Margaret
gathering.text: Coats on the back pews. Seventeen, counting you. Take the front. We will start when you do.

welcome.speaker: You
welcome.text: Good morning. Thank you for coming. One hymn the room already knows, then a short word.

hymn.text: They sing. Frank stays in the pew. Sarah stands for the second verse. Harold knows every word.

sermon.speaker: You
sermon.text: One theme for a first Sunday. The room can hold one honest thing.

choices.text: Hope. The tiredness is real, and so is the next morning.
choices.thought: They listened. That felt good. Maybe too good.

choices.text: Forgiveness. No names. The hurt in the room is still allowed.
choices.thought: They listened. That felt good. Maybe too good.

choices.text: Service. Faith that picks up a screwdriver.
choices.thought: They listened. That felt good. Maybe too good.

preach_hope.speaker: You
preach_hope.text: You talk about a small church that is still worth opening. You do not promise a crowd.

closing_hope.speaker: You
closing_hope.text: Go in peace. Hope is something you practice on Monday, not a feeling you owe me.

preach_forgiveness.speaker: You
preach_forgiveness.text: You talk about forgiveness without naming Alden Reece. You do not ask anyone to be finished.

closing_forgiveness.speaker: You
closing_forgiveness.text: Go in peace. Forgiveness can take longer than a Sunday. That is allowed.

preach_service.speaker: You
preach_service.text: You name the nursery, the side door, and the front step. Work the room can see.

closing_service.speaker: You
closing_service.text: Go in peace. If faith means anything here this week, it picks something up.
